system.description:
You select up to 3 willing creatures in range, that you can see, other than yourself, reinforcing their confidence in themselves, allowing them to act with little to no hesitation. For the duration, whenever a target creature makes an Ability or Skill check, they add 1d4 to the result.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the duration of this jutsu becomes Concentration, up to 10 minutes. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the duration of this jutsu becomes 10 minutes, no concentration needed.
